This is **not** a diff tool and does **not** track changes. It assesses the present state of the code relative to the feature's artifacts — no git, no branch comparison, no history.
The stage's **only** writes are its round report (step 6) and appending a new `## Phase N: Convergence` section to `tasks.md`.

rewrite, renumber, reorder, or delete any existing task (including tasks from a prior Convergence phase);
modify, create, or delete any application code — completing the appended tasks is the job of the implement stage
When the codebase already satisfies everything, the stage MUST leave `tasks.md` **byte-for-byte unchanged** (no empty Convergence header)
and record a clean result in its round report.
